    product_category: category
  }
];

// Применяем фильтры
let filtered = suppliers;

// Фильтр по MOQ
if (moq && moq !== 'any') {
  const moqValue = parseInt(moq);
  filtered = filtered.filter(s => {
    const supplierMoq = parseInt(s.moq);
    return !isNaN(supplierMoq) && supplierMoq <= moqValue;
  });
}

// Фильтр по цене
if (priceRange && priceRange !== 'any') {
  const [min, max] = priceRange.split('_').map(p => parseFloat(p) || 0);
  filtered = filtered.filter(s => {
    return s.price >= min && (max === 0 || s.price <= max);
  });
}

// Сортировка по качеству
filtered.sort((a, b) => {
  const scoreA = (a.rating * 0.4) + (a.total_transactions / 10000 * 0.3) + (a.verified ? 0.2 : 0) + (a.gold_supplier ? 0.1 : 0);
  const scoreB = (b.rating * 0.4) + (b.total_transactions / 10000 * 0.3) + (b.verified ? 0.2 : 0) + (b.gold_supplier ? 0.1 : 0);
  return scoreB - scoreA;
});

// Возвращаем топ-10
const topSuppliers = filtered.slice(0, 10);

console.log(`Found ${topSuppliers.length} suppliers after filtering`);

return topSuppliers.map(supplier => ({
  json: supplier
}));
